EXPRESSION: a relaxed, relieved look. skin_exposure: bold — inside the crop, the chosen outfit is worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders and collarbones, skin clearly showing; the crop stays exactly where CROP sets it and never moves down to show more; intimate areas covered

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot.
